register.labelZh: TICK 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: tick away 可以描述時鐘在安靜環境中持續發出的規律滴答聲。；當某人正在等候、面對限期或所餘時間不多時,可以使用 tick away、tick by 和 tick past。；tick off 可以描述在核對或完成某人的姓名、工作或其他項目後,在名單上打剔。；tick over 常用來表示車輛停下時,引擎仍然低速運轉。
register.summaryEn: Tick away can describe the regular sound of a clock continuing in a quiet room. Tick away, tick by and tick past are useful when somebody is waiting, facing a deadline or running out of time. Tick off helps you describe marking names, jobs or other items after they have been checked or completed. Tick over commonly appears when people talk about an engine continuing to run while a vehicle is not moving.

fixedVariable.variableZh: (時鐘滴答地走過每一分鐘。)The minutes ticked away.(時間一分一秒地過去。)In the first sentence, the clock marks the passing time. In the second, the minutes themselvespass.第一句表示時鐘滴答地記錄時間;第二句則表示分鐘本身正在流逝。；使用 it 或 them 時,把它放在 TICK 和 OFF 中間。；核心表達是 tick over。它可以配合不同句式使用。
fixedVariable.variableEn: Compare these two uses: The clock ticked away the minutes. When using it or them with tick off, place the word between TICK and OFF: tick it off tick them off The core expression is tick over. It can appear in different sentence forms: let the engine tick over leave the engine ticking over keep the engine ticking over
